Message:
pinctrl: sh-pfc: r8a7796: Deduplicate VIN5 pin definitions

Use union vin_data16 and VIN_DATA_PIN_GROUP() to reduce redundancies in
pin definitions for the VIN5 channel.

This reduces kernel size by 240 bytes.
